title: Menu-Driven Calculator
description:
```
=== CALCULATOR ===
1) Add  2) Subtract  3) Multiply  4) Divide  5) Power  0) Quit
Choice: 4
Enter two numbers: 10 0
Error: division by zero!
Choice: 5
Enter two numbers: 2 10
Result: 1024
Choice: 0
Goodbye!
```
hints: For division, check `b == 0` inside `case 4` before dividing, and print the error instead.
A `case` without `break` falls through into the next one, which is almost never what you want here (lesson 3.02).
requirements: Write your own integer `power` with a loop (no `std::pow`)
